scope: Freeze and check the downstream statistical core before seeing the real replay-to-change association. Mathematical fixtures are not the required full spike-level calibration.
response: unchanged POST-minus-PRE covariate-adjusted directional RUN coordination
pair_orientation: original distinct unit_a < unit_b; all features and outcomes change sign under exchange of neuron A and B
feature_scaling: weighted RMS from training animals only; no centering; zero RMS becomes 1 without dropping a field
baseline_fit: weighted least squares; all baseline features including PRE are unpenalized
augmented_fit: joint weighted least squares with a fixed L2 penalty of 1 on the standardized replay-order coefficient only; baseline remains unpenalized
prediction_split: leave one complete animal out; every recording, pause and pair for that animal stays outside training
weights: equal animal, equal recording within animal, equal pause within recording, equal pair within pause
event_aggregation: mean original/shuffled pair-order over independently validated events within each frozen pause; include inactive pairs and zero-event pauses as zero-order rows; pair participation is the fraction of validated events with both units active
shuffle_pipeline: every shuffled event preserves the complete population-bin vectors, cell totals, participation and duration; independently regenerate features and refit baseline and augmented models for every control; do not reverse fitted feature signs
informative_animal_accounting: Retain zero-event/zero-order animals and every frozen pause in prediction and denominator tables. Report animals with nonzero original order separately; fewer than three informative animals cannot satisfy the development coverage check even when the total cohort is larger. This is not a power certificate or biological gate pass.
development_readouts: held-out weighted MSE improvement by animal and control
original gain minus each animal's median shuffled gain
development_fixture_design: Four artificial animals, two artificial recordings per animal, two pauses per recording, eight units. Keep the first pause per animal as a zero-event observation. Other pauses contain two synthetic 24-bin population bursts of width 5 ms. The same count-preserving order features are reused across four planted-response algebra checks, not interpreted as neural generators.
independent_math_check: Profile order against an independently formed unpenalized weighted baseline projection, solve scalar ridge and independently recompute animal scores; compare every prediction at fixed rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12
real_fit_prerequisites: native-LFP theta and all frozen RUN nuisance controls
full end-to-end spike-level six-generator calibration including cohort and replay selection
claim_boundary: A train-only mathematical fixture is not calibration of real replay selection, rate adjustment, measurement error or animal-level biological inference. No real associations, p-values, confidence intervals, synaptic interpretation or manuscript claim changes in this delivery. All earlier exclusions and the PF missing-theta stopgate remain unchanged.
